project_register.purpose: Compile bounded NEO contracts to existing Bitcoin Script and evaluate them locally

architecture_inventory.name: Bitcoin Virtual Machine
architecture_inventory.role: Bounded local Bitcoin witness-v0 Script subset evaluator

architecture_inventory.name: NEO Virtual Machine
architecture_inventory.role: Strict NEO contract compiler and local execution orchestration

decision_log.decision: Keep both project-scoped names: NEO NVM for orchestration, NEO BVM for Bitcoin execution
Use existing Bitcoin witness-v0 Script; do not invent Bitcoin consensus opcodes or require Ethereum
Gate 1 is a bounded local hashlock prototype; Bitcoin Core remains the validation authority for future node tests
Receipt hashes identify local summaries and are never represented as on-chain proofs

prioritized_backlog.deliverable: Publish the tested feature branch and open a draft PR after explicit public-repository publication approval required by automatic review
Isolated Bitcoin Core regtest harness for matching and mismatching witnesses, script mutations and resource-boundary vectors
Reviewed signature and timelock contract templates, transaction-context validation and differential tests
Verify NEOpass and NeoMask capabilities before adding authorized PSBT workflows
Define explicit Counterparty and NOMNI adapter semantics without treating local VM acceptance as token settlement

next_milestone: NEO-VM-G2: independent Bitcoin Core regtest acceptance and rejection evidence; no real funds
